description.en: See your team at work. Follow tasks, tool calls and listening decisions in one view.
description.zh-CN: 查看团队如何协作，在一个页面跟进任务、工具调用与监听决策。

description.en: Bring Router into your channels. Receive messages and report progress in the same thread.
description.zh-CN: 让 Router 进入工作群聊，在原会话中接收消息并报告任务进展。

description.en: Turn issues into coordinated work. Keep discussions and delivery connected to your team’s tracker.
description.zh-CN: 从事项开始协作，让讨论和交付回到团队的任务管理流程。
